breakdown.description: Prandtl number value is inconsistent with the stated fluid (air at 25 C does not have Pr≈7).
breakdown.reason: The agent failed to resolve the core inconsistency. It accepted the user's incorrect premise that air at 25°C has a Prandtl number of 7.0. The ground truth correctly identifies that air at this temperature has a Pr of ~0.7 and that Pr=7.0 corresponds to a different fluid like water. The agent should have corrected this physical impossibility instead of proceeding with the flawed calculation.
